corridor.source: Development-time public Valhalla truck costing over OpenStreetMap (valhalla1.openstreetmap.de, loaded-semi options matching tools/reroute_leg.py), sampled 2026-09-22. speed_limits.source: Coarse placeholder ~90 km/h rural BC/YT Alaska Highway truck context for Phase A north filament; CA statutory truck caps still a named honesty debt (not a harvested maxspeed:hgv tag).

state_crossings.place: Yukon–British Columbia line on the Alaska Highway (near Contact Creek / Lower Post)
state_crossings.source: Approximate British Columbia–Yukon line on the Alaska Highway near Contact Creek / Lower Post, matched to public Valhalla truck-costing geometry (development-time, valhalla1.openstreetmap.de). Coarse at_mi from ~12 mi YT remainder into Watson Lake (Historic Mile ~627 border vs Mile ~635 Watson Lake).
